title: My 7 YEAR Dream Game Idea Is Becoming a Reality! :)
author: Old_Mortgage_4584
selftext:
I know a lot of people love to complain about AI ruining everything but i havent smiled like this in a looong time.

Finally playing the game my teenage self dreamed about back in 2019 and it feels surreal to see that old idea of this game become true. Sorry for bad quality.

What do you all think of the demo so far?

comments.author: KingofKingsofKingsof
comments.body:
Ignore the comments, friend.  Most people on Reddit are c\*nts because they can hide behind anonymity, and they treat everyone else as potential competitors.  They are also so afraid of being review bombed that they will destroy anybody who is making a game that they perceive is 'giving the secret away' by being too obviously AI.  Many people are helpful, however, and you can also use the c\*nts to get some honest reactions.  Like, if they say it looks too much like Hollow Knight, then that is an indicartor of how others will see your game.  Having never played Hollow Knight I can't speak too much to that aspect gameplay-wise, other than it is white character (its a candle, duh) in a dark background (its a candle!).  

The concept of playing as a candle is interesting.  Do you have your core game loop sorted out?  I can imagine, being a candle, that you will burn out over time, giving a time limit to achieve things.  Candles also can't regrow their wax.  Are you actually a candle, or are you perhaps the flame, and you need to survive by hopping from candle to candle.  Some candles can be possessed by the player and move.  Some might move automatically, and the flame needs to hop from candle to candle?  Just a few thoughts.  

  
Get your gameplay loop sorted in a single level.  Don't worry too much about story or art style at this point.  Get that first level sorted, then only once it is 90% there should you progress.  You can add features as you go, but you need to get the basic game play more or less right.  You can tweak movement speed etc.
